parent_objective: SQ-053: audit + fact-check + remediate tier-2 pages (ranks 31-60); feed Commander synthesis and remediation
context:
SITE: utilityexplained.com — Hugo static site, US utility-bill education, affiliate + AdSense (blocked 'Low value content'; accuracy/evidence is the gate). Source of truth: content/blog/<slug>.md. Reader: US resident with a bill in hand. This is TIER 2 (site traffic ranks 31-60) — lower traffic, longer tail: expect thinner pages, more fee-cluster overlap, and some instant-exit defects. Engagement data + tier context: .squad/SQ-053/evidence.md (read it first).
SITE STANDARDS SET TODAY (do not contradict): national electric anchor = 900 kWh × 18.34¢ = $165/mo, 2024 actual average $144 (EIA); energy.gov/energysaver/* URLs are DEAD sitewide (live successors: energystar.gov/saveathome/heating-cooling[.../duct-sealing], energy.gov/save/home-upgrades, energy.gov/cmei/femp/evaluating-your-utility-rate-options) — flag any remaining; verified municipal anchors: Seattle sewer $20.18/CCF, Philly $5.16/CCF flat, SFPUC 90% of water × $20.74/unit; EPA: 82 gal/day/person, 9,400 gal/yr household leaks, 10-min dye test, 12,000-gal/mo winter family-of-4 threshold; RECS 2020: heating+cooling 52%, 'other devices' 23% (no standby share exists).

AUDIT RUBRIC per page: (1) thin/shallow/outdated/duplicate/generic — word count vs topic demand, overlap with siblings (this tier is the fee-cluster heart); (2) false/inaccurate/unsupported claims — extract 3-6 checkable claims; verify via web_search/web_fetch vs authoritative sources (EIA, DOE, ENERGY STAR, EPA, FTC, state PUCs, statutes); verdict CONFIRMED/REFUTED/UNVERIFIED with URL + retrieved date 2026-08-29; never invent sources; (3) AI slop — exact-quote filler/repetition/vague hedging without decision rules; (4) intent alignment + completeness vs the slug's promise; (5) E-E-A-T — zero-outbound-source pages are the site's #1 credibility risk; (6) on-page SEO — title/meta/headings/internal links/schema, specific.

OUTPUT CONTRACT per assigned page:
PAGE: <slug>
RATING: <A|B|C|D|F> — one-line justification
INTENT: <primary intent> — <aligned|partial|mismatched> + why (<=15 words)
ISSUES: 3-6 bullets, each naming exact section/heading/quote
FACTS: 3-6 lines: "<claim>" — CONFIRMED/REFUTED/UNVERIFIED — <evidence URL / what contradicts>
WEAKCOPY: 2-4 exact quoted sentences with section names
FIXES: specific (remove X / rewrite Y / verify Z against <source> / expand with <specific> / consolidate into <slug> / redirect) — executable without re-reading
SEO: title/meta/headings/links/schema opportunities, specific
EFFORT: S|M|L · IMPACT: H|M|L — one-line rationale

resources.notes: Evidence: .squad/SQ-053/evidence.md. Full rubric/contract apply to PART B only.

constraints: No claims about Google's ranking systems — best practice framing only
Every fix names its target section/heading/quote/claim
Every factual verdict carries URL + retrieved date 2026-08-29 or NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW
If web verification fails, say UNVERIFIED — never fabricate
success_criteria: Full OUTPUT CONTRACT block per page
3-6 factual claims per page verified (URL+date) or labeled NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW
Fixes executable without re-reading the page
